lead: Bhupen Hazarika was an Indian actor, born on 8 September 1926 in Assam.
He died on 5 November 2011 in Mumbai at the age of 85.
He has 21 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the Assam Legislative Assembly.
This profile collects the Bhupen facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Bhupen Hazarika — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Bhupen Hazarika was born on 8 September 1926 in Assam, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
He is a sibling of Sudakshina Sarma.
He received his education at Cotton University and Banaras Hindu University.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Bhupen Hazarika — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists actor, film director, singer, composer, writer and music director as his occupations.
He has held the following offices: Member of the Assam Legislative Assembly. He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
